description:
My boyfriend, a second-generation tycoon, caught Acute Meow-Meow Syndrome? My boyfriend, Ko Yang-jun, has a disease that makes him act like a cat.   
But… even after becoming a cat, his feelings for me haven't changed a bit? He can't get caught being a cat, and we can't let our office romance be discovered either!    
A bumpy romantic comedy unfolding with a cat-like beast (of a man)!

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=846330), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13585115)
